request.model: string (required, routing/echo only; the external router selects the model)

<qid>.type: noul|choice|score (bool and scale accepted as input aliases)

noul.noul: number in [0,1] = P(true); no confidence field

choice.probabilities: object keyed by option key, sums to 1
choice.confidence: number = (N*p_max-1)/(N-1), Jev default; opt-in 1 - H/log(K) via confidence_profile

score.legend: object mapping level index string to description, in order
score.confidence: number = (N*p_max-1)/(N-1), Jev default; opt-in 1 - H/log(K) via confidence_profile

limits.choice options: 2-255 per question (realized pool is model-dependent: the tokenizer must resolve each label as a single token)
